==Description==
The '''Elf''' is the first unit that spawns from the [[Elf Camp]]. It spawns when the [[Elf Camp]] is at Levels 0-2. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. It would collide with each enemy it meets until it dies.

The '''Elf''' initially has a spawnrate of 15 seconds, meaning that every 10 seconds, an '''Elf''' associated with a Level 0-2 [[Elf Camp]] will appear.

The '''Elf''' is replaced by the [[Guardian Elf]] for Levels 3-4 of the [[Elf Camp]].

==Appearance==
The '''Elf''' has pale skin and blond hair. It wears a green shirt with a brown belt and red details, green and red hat with a golden star, dark green pants and brown shoes.

==Strategy==
*The '''Elf''' is great for weak enemies that spawn initially during the round, like the [[Normal]], [[Abnormal]], [[Speedy]] or [[Quick]].
**When the [[Slow]] or [[Heavy]] enemies spawn, you should have a more solid defense than just '''Elves'''. However, multiple '''Elves''' can be used to defeat these enemies.
**When the [[Normal Boss]] or [[Elite Abnormal]] appears, you should be upgrading your [[Elf Camp]] to spawn stronger units.
*On two-pathed maps, only one '''Elf''' will spawn per Level 0-2 [[Elf Camp]]. It will go down a random path.
*The '''Elf''' can be somewhat useful against [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies if your other towers do not have hidden detection.
**The '''Elf''' cannot collide with [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemies like [[Soul]]s.
*The '''Elf''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the  [[Heavy]] or [[Elite Abnormal]].
*The '''Elf''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health.
**For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, and an '''Elf''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly defeated.

==Trivia==
*The  {{Color|Christmas2025|Classic}} skin is based on the [[Basic Elf (Cold Ambush)|Basic Elf]] enemy from [[Cold Ambush]].
*While the '''Elf''' has a range of 1.5, it cannot deal any form of damage, aside from collision damage.
**The '''Elf''' has the lowest range in the game.
